edit.description: Earlier robust response to large residuals, then baseline curvature; not a tolerance radius
edit.interpolation: smoothstep; phase is normalized over observed score nodes; no extrapolation
edit.normalization: dose is normalized over actual score nodes to a mean of one

failure_modes: Affinity is the primary objective but no decoded final affinity labels are present in role input; coordinate contrasts are proxies, so an improvement in landmark_00_soft_mass contrast does not establish improved affinity. Affinity must be assessed first, with strain and structural validity reported separately.

Component-gradient cancellation: the delta schedule changes only the robust/base weighting of the same scalar reward, so a changed scalar value does not prove changed injection. Require gradient-direction and delivered-dose checks; if C1 and C2 give indistinguishable landmark_00_soft_mass trajectory contrasts and endpoint affinity under the same seeds and dose, the stage-dependent curvature is falsified.

The observed curve is non-monotone with 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict, and whole-window soft-mass z magnitudes are small (|z| < ~0.64) with no accepted polynomial; the early-window transient may be noise rather than a stable phase, so the timing benefit may not replicate across seeds.

The default phase knot at 0.5 is an experimental hypothesis, not a discovered stage boundary; no independently stable profile supports a data-derived knot, and no extrapolation beyond the observed support [0.0, 0.49] is licensed.
Stage and temporal profiles are unavailable and selection/survival evidence was not queried, so no claim about descendant survival or measured final benefit is made.
rationale: H001 is the executable hypothesis: the landmark_00_soft_mass endpoint coordinate contrast is non-monotone over the observed score-node support (rise early, fall late), so a single constant curvature cannot match both phases. C1_robust_to_base implements exactly that timing (delta 0.5 -> 0.75 -> 1.0 over knots 0/0.5/1, smoothstep, dose held at 1, teachers and temperatures frozen), i.e. earlier robust response to large residuals followed by baseline curvature. C2_constant_curvature is the matched discrete-mean control and C3_base_to_robust_control is the opposite-timing control, so the comparison is attributable to timing rather than to mean delta or dose. H002 supports the smoothstep interpolation over observed score nodes rather than a hard data-derived knot, consistent with the weak, non-polynomial, multi-sign-change soft-mass trends. The edit is confined to the reward route with dose_factors=1 and no temperature change, as the contract requires.
